plan: A shotgun outlaw who deals huge damage up close and takes hits well.
aSurveiller: His R (Collateral Damage). He fires a shell that explodes behind the target: don't stand behind an ally who gets hit.
contrer: Keep your distance: his shotgun hurts a lot up close.
His pellets stop on the first one hit: put a minion or a monster between you.
Engage him while he reloads: he has to stop after two shots.
forces: Very strong early in the jungle.
faiblesses: Has to reload after two shots.
Weak if kept at a distance.

sorts.P: Fires like a shotgun; has to reload.
sorts.Q: Projectile that explodes after a delay.
sorts.R: Shell that explodes behind the target.

momentFort: Strong from the start, dangerous in the mid game.
